_comment: Template for tools/config.json. Copy is unnecessary — `python tools/setup.py` writes the real file. Every value below is discovered or created by setup; they are listed here so you can see what the tooling depends on, and so a value can be pinned by hand if you are attaching OneSafe to workspaces that already exist.
_required_before_setup: Only tenantId and scannerAppId/scannerSpObjectId cannot be discovered without an Entra app. setup.py creates that app for you unless --scanner-app-id is passed.
_sql_endpoint: Discovered from the lakehouse after creation. sqlEndpointId — not lakehouseId — is what Direct Lake M expressions need.
_scanner: Entra app registration used by the notebooks to call the admin and Graph APIs. Its client secret is NOT stored here — it goes to OneLake via tools/upload_config.py.
_app: Entra SPA registration the front-end signs users in with. Delegated Power BI access only; it never holds elevated rights of its own.
_admin_group: Optional. Security group granted read on the semantic model by tools/secure_model.py. Leave blank to skip.
_demo: Optional sandbox used by tools/seed_*.py and notebooks 97/98 to demonstrate OneLake and semantic-model RLS/CLS. Created by `setup.py --with-demo`. demoPrincipals are the users the demo roles are assigned to — they must already exist in your tenant.
